abstract: OBJECTIVES: To determine whether frozen section analysis (FSA) assists safe conservative surgery for men presenting with suspected testicular tumors. METHODS: We performed a retrospective review of intraoperative testicular FSA used at a single university institution during an 11-year period. The exclusion criteria included lesions of paratesticular origin, size greater than 5 cm, and the known presence of elevated tumor markers or metastatic disease. RESULTS: Eighty men underwent FSA, facilitating the diagnosis of germ cell malignancy in 51 (54.3%) of the 94 new cases encountered during this period. Malignancy was reported by FSA in 52 patients (65.0%), but was later revised in 3 to benign Leydig cell tumor after orchiectomy. Also, 2 of 27 specimens reported as benign by FSA were revised to malignant after analysis of paraffin-embedded tissue from the biopsies. Both were seminoma and required delayed orchiectomy. FSA was reported as "suspicious" (intratubular germ cell neoplasia with necrosis) in 1 patient, in whom orchiectomy was performed and malignancy confirmed. In total, orchiectomy was avoided in 25 cases (31.3%). The positive and negative predictive value for FSA in the diagnosis of testicular malignancy was 94.2% and 92.6%, respectively. Of 13 lesions 1 cm or less, 10 (76.9%) were benign. All 26 lesions greater than 3 cm were malignant. A clear correlation between lesion size and the diagnosis of malignancy was demonstrated. CONCLUSIONS: FSA is a valuable tool assisting testicular preservation. Lesion size correlated with incidence of malignancy; therefore, FSA may be best used for small testicular lesions suitable for excision biopsy.
abstract_ja:
目的：精巣腫瘍が疑われる男性において、術中凍結切片診断(FSA)が安全な精巣温存手術に有用かを検討する。
方法：ある大学施設で11年間に術中に実施された精巣FSAを後方視的に検討した。除外基準は精巣傍組織由来の病変、5 cmを超える病変、腫瘍マーカー高値または転移病変の確認とした。
結果：80例がFSAを受け、この期間の新規症例94例のうち51例(54.3%)で胚細胞由来の悪性腫瘍の診断に寄与した。FSAで悪性と報告されたのは52例(65.0%)で、そのうち3例は精巣摘除後に精巣ライディッヒ細胞腫瘍と修正された。FSAで良性とされた27例中2例はパラフィン包埋組織の解析で悪性に修正され、いずれもセミノーマで、後日の精巣摘除を要した。FSAで「疑わしい」(精細管内胚細胞腫瘍with壊死)と報告された1例は、精巣摘除後に悪性と確認された。全体として25例(31.3%)で精巣摘除を回避できた。FSAの陽性的中率は94.2%、陰性的中率は92.6%であった。1 cm以下の13病変のうち10例(76.9%)は良性であった。3 cmを超える26病変はすべて悪性であった。病変サイズと悪性の診断との間に明確な相関が認められた。
結論：FSAは精巣温存に有用なツールである。病変サイズは悪性の発生率と相関したため、切除生検に適した小さな精巣病変にFSAを用いるのが最も有用かもしれない。
